artworks.title: Sunrise, Woods of Clamard (Lever du soleil, bois de Clamard)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a path surrounded by trees, leading towards a bright area in the distance. The intricate etching style features crosshatched lines depicting texture and depth, especially in the trees and undergrowth. The monochromatic color palette uses shades of black and gray on a soft, off-white background, emphasizing light and shadows. The trees frame the composition, with branches arching upwards, and the path leads towards the brighter center, creating a sense of enclosure and openness.

artworks.title: Wheelwright's Home (La maison du charron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with two structures on the left and right. There is a pathway leading into the scene. Trees with intricate foliage are on the right side. In the distance, there are expansive fields with delicate strokes indicating depth. The image is done in a monochromatic palette with varying black ink intensities. The artist's attention to detail is evident in capturing textures and shadows. A signature in the bottom right corner suggests authorship.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a grove of trees seen from a slightly elevated perspective. The focus is on the trees against the sky, with a hint of a small structure in the background. The style resembles an etching with intricate lines and cross-hatching depicting texture and depth, portraying dappled light and shadow among the trees. The color scheme is monochromatic in black and grey, accentuating contrast and detail. One side of the image is dense and dark with foliage and shadows, while the other side is lighter and sketchier, suggesting openness or a clearing.

artworks.title: Near the Mill (Pres du moulin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tree-lined body of water. Trees dominate the middle of the composition, leading the eye to a more open landscape in the distance. The trees have a dynamic texture created by fluid lines. The etching technique is used to show light and shadow, giving depth to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and gray to define form and space, creating a tranquil atmosphere. A figure is seen fishing, adding to the sense of peace and solitude. The background fades into the distance, with details becoming less distinct.

artworks.title: Prospect (Le point de vue)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a vast landscape stretching towards the horizon. In the upper third, there are rolling hills and clusters of foliage. The land closer to the viewer is textured with soft, flowing lines implying grassy expanses and undulating terrain. Two small figures are positioned towards the left, overlooking the view. The etching is monochromatic, using various line weights and densities for depth and texture, creating a subdued visual impact emphasizing the serene landscape.

artworks.title: Prospect (Le point de vue)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with fields, trees, distant hills, and an overcast sky. It is created with detailed etching, using cross-hatching for texture and depth. Darker strokes are used for the foreground, contrasting with lighter tones in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia and black tones depicting the terrain and sky.

artworks.title: The House of the Well (La maison du puits)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape scene. The viewpoint is at eye level, showing gently sloping terrain with a low horizon. A line of trees marks the horizon, blending into dense foliage that extends from left to right. The etching technique uses fine, linear brushstrokes to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia. An indistinct figure is visible near some trees in the foreground. Hills and more trees can be seen in the background.

artworks.title: Lord A. Tennyson, 3rd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of the head and neck of an elderly man shown in profile, facing to the right. He has a long nose, a long, curly beard, and long, flowing hair. The man appears to be in a thoughtful pose, with his head slightly tilted forward. The sketch is detailed, especially highlighting the texture of his hair and beard in fine lines. The man is not shown wearing any visible clothing, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Cottage with a Cart (Chaumiere a la charette)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a row of haystacks in the center. A rustic cart is next to the haystacks. The background has a gradient indicating the horizon. Details are depicted using fine etching techniques, showing grass and the cart's structure. The color scheme is warm with sepia and brown tones. Some bushes and small trees are present in the scene.

artworks.title: Man and Wife Seated by the Road with a Basket(Homme et femme assis au bord de la rou te aven un panier)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing two people with only their upper bodies visible. Both individuals are depicted sitting or reclining closely together. The person on the left is wearing a hooded garment that covers their head, with their downturned face slightly visible. The person on the right has short hair and appears to be resting their head on the left person's shoulder. Below the individuals, there is a wicker basket sitting on the ground beside them. The background features textured lines suggesting vegetation or foliage, giving the impression of an outdoor setting. The entire composition is rendered in detailed crosshatching.

artworks.title: German Forest, Downley
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up view of the base and trunks of several large trees. The dense and towering trees dominate the view, extending upward beyond the edges of the image. The artwork features intricate etching lines to render the texture of the bark and outline the leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, composed of shades of sepia and dark brown, highlighting the detailed line work.

artworks.title: Man with a Punt, Figure to the Right (Pecheurs des truites)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint? on light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with a body of water, tall trees, and a small boat near the shore. The horizon is low with distant merging trees. A figure is seen near the boat. The scene features lush foliage, light and shadow play, delicate lines, and shading suggesting texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic in beige and light brown tones.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man's head and partial neck in profile. He faces left, with his face and neck fully visible. The man has a prominent nose, brow, and full beard. His short, wavy hair is depicted with loose lines. The drawing captures details of his facial features with defined lines indicating depth. The background is plain and neutral, focusing on the sketch. There are no visible clothing details or additional objects.

artworks.title: Man and Woman under a Tree
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two people sitting side by side. The person on the left is seated with their body slightly leaning forward, resting their chin on their hand. They have a featureless face obscured by a hooded garment, and their hair is not visible. This person is dressed in a long, flowing cloak or robe that covers most of their body. Beside them on the ground lies a woven basket. The person on the right is seated upright, holding a cup or mug in one hand and resting their other hand on their knee. Their facial features are slightly more defined, with visible eyes and a beard or stubble, and they appear to have short hair. They are dressed in a shirt and trousers, with visible footwear, and an object resembling a tool, possibly an axe, rests on the ground near their feet. In the background, two large, textured trees stand prominently behind the people, with smaller trees and foliage extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Young Peasant (Jeune paysanne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person seated and facing forward. The individual has short, neat hair covered by a cap or cloth, with facial features including a straight nose, arched eyebrows, and defined lips. They wear a high-necked, plain garment and there are no accessories. The background is plain, with soft lines and shading emphasizing the person's features.

artworks.title: His Eminence Cardinal Manning, 1st plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated and holding an open book. The person has detailed facial features, thin hair covered with a skullcap, and is wearing a robe with buttons down the front. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Reading of the Office of the Day (La lecture de l'office)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man in a side profile view. He is seated or standing, leaning slightly forward. He has a pronounced forehead, a prominent bald head, short white or grey hair, distinct nose, and frown lines. The man is reading a large, open book, holding it with one hand while the other hand is raised slightly. He wears a robe with a dark collar and a square decoration hanging from his neck. A gold ring is on his left third finger. The background features a plain wall with a small-paned window letting in light.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son, 1st plate (L'enfant prodigue)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a kneeling position on the ground with one knee on the earth and the other bent upright. The individual is resting their head on one hand leaned on their knee, while their other hand grasps a staff. The person is topless, wearing loose, short pants or a waist wrap, with medium-length hair parted slightly. Their facial features include a serious expression, with a prominent profile. Surrounding the person is a fence or wooden structure, with indistinct landscape lines in the background. The ground appears textured, leading to a manger in front of the person, with pigs resting their heads on its edge. The artwork is done in an etching or drawing style with visible cross-hatching for shading and detail.

artworks.title: Death of the Vagabond (La mort du vagabond)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man reclining against the base of a tree, with his body stretched out along the ground. The tree leans diagonally in the composition, occupying a large portion of the left side, while the man's head rests against its trunk, gazing upwards. The horizon is not distinctly visible, as the scene is focused on the immediate surroundings of the tree and the man. There is a subtle background of softly depicted foliage and an indistinct, slightly darker area indicating distant terrain. The artwork is executed in a detailed line technique that emphasizes the texture of the tree bark and the folds of the man’s clothing, suggesting a printmaking or etching process. The image is rendered in a monochromatic sepia tone, which adds to the somber and contemplative atmosphere, with the darkest shades highlighting the contours and details.

artworks.title: Head of an English Laborer (Tete d'ouvrier anglais (Le berger))
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a head-and-shoulders profile view of a bearded man facing to the right. He appears slightly hunched, with his shoulders forward, and is turned to the side. His facial features include a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and pronounced cheekbones. He has long hair and a full beard, wears a textured hat with a brim, and has a coat or cape draped over his shoulders. The background is plain with cross-hatched shading. The piece is signed by the artist A. Legros at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Leon Gambetta, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a profile view from the chest up. He is facing to the left of the image. The man has prominent facial features including a forehead, nose, lips, beard, and mustache. His hair is wavy and receding slightly at the temples. He is dressed in a high-collared shirt with a bow tie, and a partially detailed jacket or coat. The background has horizontal lines, giving a textured appearance. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The style of the image suggests it is an etched portrait.

artworks.title: Poet (Le poete)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person's head and upper shoulders, facing forward in a shadowy style. The individual has a long beard and hair framing the face. The clothing is dark and the background is a dark, textured surface with a sepia-toned hue. The bottom right corner is signed "A. Legros." There are no accessories or objects being held by the subject.

artworks.title: Egg-sellers, 2nd plate (Les marchandes d'oeufs)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two seated individuals. They are wearing hoods and headscarves. Their facial features appear aged, with furrowed brows and sunken eyes. They wear dark cloaks. In front of them is a basket. The background is a textured wall.

artworks.title: Philospher (Le philosophe)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure depicted in profile from the waist up against a backdrop of stone or rock formations. The person is positioned slightly forward, with the body shrouded in a draped cloth that covers most of their body, including their feet visible at the bottom. Their facial features, including a pronounced nose and a bearded jawline, are sketched in a somewhat shadowed manner. The hair appears curly and textured. Around the figure, there is a tree with a few visible branches and leaves. The etching includes an artist's signature, "A. Legros," at the bottom right corner.
